answer: Reaching eligibility takes 70 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone pays for every seat it wants. The mirror register is checked at draw time, pulse lists the eligible set, and knoll seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 70 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. A 223 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
